cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: I'm Valerie Sanderson and at 15:00 GMT on Tuesday the 29th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是瓦莱丽·桑德森。以下是 9 月 29 日星期二格林尼治时间 15 点的主要新闻。

cues.en: Spain's government says it will ban evictions until 2030,
cues.zh: 西班牙政府表示将禁止驱逐房客直至 2030 年，

cues.en: as it tries to tackle a housing crisis that has caused widespread public anger.
cues.zh: 以应对引发民众广泛愤怒的住房危机。

cues.en: Israeli settlers attack a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank,
cues.zh: 以色列定居者袭击被占领的约旦河西岸一个巴勒斯坦村庄，

cues.en: preventing a family from returning to their home despite a ruling from the High Court.
cues.zh: 尽管高等法院已经裁决，这仍阻止一个家庭回到他们的家。

cues.en: OpenAI scraps the launch of its next model due to safety concerns.
cues.zh: OpenAI 因安全担忧取消下一代模型的发布。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, a new film about Facebook.
cues.zh: 本期播客还将介绍一部关于 Facebook 的新电影。

cues.en: What began as a cool idea became something huge and frankly monstrous,
cues.zh: 一个起初很酷的想法变得庞大，坦率说甚至有些可怕，

cues.en: a machine for pumping out misinformation and making people angry.
cues.zh: 成了一台制造错误信息、激怒人们的机器。

cues.en: A sharp upsurge in violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the occupied
cues.zh: 被占领的约旦河西岸，以色列定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力急剧增加，

cues.en: West Bank has been gaining international attention. The latest example
cues.zh: 引起了国际关注。最近的例子

cues.en: is an assault by 100 Israeli settlers who attacked a Palestinian village there,
cues.zh: 是 100 名以色列定居者袭击当地一个巴勒斯坦村庄，

cues.en: preventing a family from going back to their home which had been seized by settlers.
cues.zh: 阻止一个家庭回到被定居者夺走的家中。

cues.en: The return of the Palestinians to the village of Jalud had been coordinated with the Israeli army after a High Court ruled in their favour.
cues.zh: 巴勒斯坦人返回贾卢德村一事已与以色列军方协调，此前高等法院裁决支持他们。

cues.en: Our correspondent in Jerusalem, Yolande Knell, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们在耶路撒冷的记者约兰德·内尔告诉了我更多情况。

cues.en: The Atabasi family had been forced to leave their two homes on the edge of the village
cues.zh: 阿塔巴西一家被迫离开位于村庄边缘的两处住宅，

cues.en: of Jalud, which is just south of Nablus in the West Bank.
cues.zh: 这些住宅在约旦河西岸纳布卢斯以南、贾卢德村附近。

cues.en: That was back in July, and they had been subjected to months of harassment and settler attacks when they fled.
cues.zh: 那是在 7 月；他们逃离时已经遭受数月骚扰和定居者袭击。

cues.en: Now the Israeli High Court had ruled in their favour earlier this month, really putting out a strongly worded
cues.zh: 本月早些时候，以色列高等法院裁决支持他们，并发表措辞强硬的

cues.en: statement calling for the rule of law to be reinstated and calling on Israeli authorities to get this family back
cues.zh: 声明，要求恢复法治，并呼吁以色列当局让这个家庭回到

cues.en: to their homes. Now we were told by Mahmoud Atabasi that he was called late at night and told
cues.zh: 他们的家中。马哈茂德·阿塔巴西告诉我们，他深夜接到电话，被告知

cues.en: that the coordination had come through around midnight local time.
cues.zh: 协调已在当地时间午夜左右完成。

cues.en: So he, one of his sons and his wife rushed off to these houses.
cues.zh: 于是他和一个儿子及妻子赶往这些房屋。

cues.en: They were being escorted by Israeli soldiers and Israeli police.
cues.zh: 以色列士兵和警察为他们护送。

cues.en: But it seems that what happened at the same time was that one of the WhatsApp groups used by these extremist settlers to coordinate their actions put
cues.zh: 但事情似乎同时发生：这些极端定居者用来协调行动的一个 WhatsApp 群组发出

cues.en: out an alert saying that the family they had managed to force out was indeed returning,
cues.zh: 警报称他们设法赶走的那个家庭确实正在返回，

cues.en: and calling on settlers to come and join an action to stop that return from happening.
cues.zh: 并号召定居者前来参与阻止其返回的行动。

cues.en: The family told us that they had just inspected the extensive damage to one of their properties.
cues.zh: 这家人告诉我们，他们刚检查过其中一处房产遭受的严重破坏。

cues.en: They sent us a video where you could just see
cues.zh: 他们给我们发来一段视频，可以看到

cues.en: how settlers have torn it apart, smashing the toilet, smashing up the doors, pulling out the electrical fittings.
cues.zh: 定居者如何将房屋毁坏：砸碎马桶、砸坏门、拆出电气装置。

cues.en: And just as they were in the process of that inspection, settlers started to throw stones at the house.
cues.zh: 就在他们检查时，定居者开始向房屋投掷石块。

cues.en: They were told, they said, there were more than 100 of them. That is the same as the statement that's come from the Israeli military.
cues.zh: 他们说，有人告诉他们，现场有一百多人。这与以色列军方的声明一致。

cues.en: The family said that there were actually five or six soldiers that helped them initially to get into an Israeli military vehicle,
cues.zh: 这家人说，最初有五六名士兵帮助他们进入一辆以色列军车，

cues.en: so that they could leave the scene.
cues.zh: 以便他们离开现场。

cues.en: That vehicle was attacked with its tyres slashed, they said, and then they were put into an armoured vehicle and taken away.
cues.zh: 他们说，那辆车遭到袭击、轮胎被割破；随后他们被转移到一辆装甲车中带走。

cues.en: After they left, their houses were set on fire.
cues.zh: 他们离开后，房屋被纵火焚烧。

cues.en: How are the Israeli authorities reacting to this, Yolande?
cues.zh: 约兰德，以色列当局对此有何反应？

cues.en: Because this happened following a High Court ruling that the family should return.
cues.zh: 因为这件事发生在高等法院裁决该家庭应当返回之后。

cues.en: That's right, and I think it just is a very clear illustration of
cues.zh: 没错。我认为这非常清楚地说明了

cues.en: how the Israeli authorities are struggling or indeed failing to deal with settler violence,
cues.zh: 以色列当局正努力、甚至未能应对定居者暴力，

cues.en: particularly under the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu,
cues.zh: 尤其是在本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理领导的政府下，

cues.en: who, with the far-right elements in his government, has really promoted rapid settlement expansion.
cues.zh: 他与政府中的极右翼势力一起，确实推动了定居点的快速扩张。

cues.en: And the UN is saying that settler violence in the West Bank is at an all-time high.
cues.zh: 联合国表示，约旦河西岸的定居者暴力已达到历史最高水平。

cues.en: Now the Israeli prime minister did put out a statement strongly condemning what had happened,
cues.zh: 以色列总理确实发表声明强烈谴责所发生的事件，

cues.en: but he was referring to the attacks on the Israeli security forces.
cues.zh: 但他指的是针对以色列安全部队的袭击。

cues.en: Three border police were lightly injured, we're told. The Israeli president has said there has to be decisive action,
cues.zh: 据报道，三名边防警察受轻伤。以色列总统表示必须采取果断行动，

cues.en: and said this is a moral stain, particularly coming at the time of the Jewish high holiday of Sukkot.
cues.zh: 并称这是一道道德污点，尤其发生在犹太教重要节日住棚节期间。

cues.en: Yolande Knell in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 约兰德·内尔在耶路撒冷报道。

cues.en: The Spanish government has approved a proposed ban on
cues.zh: 西班牙政府批准了一项拟议的禁驱逐令，

cues.en: evictions until 2030 amid protests across the country over housing.
cues.zh: 将驱逐禁令延长至2030年，此前全国各地因住房问题爆发抗议。

cues.en: The issue came into sharp focus when an 87-year-old
cues.zh: 一名87岁老妇的遭遇令这个问题骤然受到关注。

cues.en: woman who'd lived in her Madrid apartment for decades was evicted
cues.zh: 她在马德里的公寓住了几十年，却遭到驱逐，

cues.en: when she could no longer afford the massive increase in her rent.
cues.zh: 她再也负担不起房租的大幅上涨。

cues.en: Her situation drew huge publicity, and now ministers have decided
cues.zh: 她的遭遇受到广泛关注，如今部长们决定

cues.en: to introduce new housing decrees which they say are in response to the demands of the people.
cues.zh: 推出新的住房法令，并称这是对民众诉求的回应。

cues.en: The case of pensioner Mari Carmen Abascal seems to have been resolved.
cues.zh: 养老金领取者玛丽·卡门·阿瓦斯卡尔的案件似乎已经解决。

cues.en: Her lawyer Beatriz Duro said that she would be allowed to return
cues.zh: 她的律师贝阿特丽斯·杜罗说，她获准返回住处，

cues.en: paying a rent similar to the old one.
cues.zh: 支付与原来相近的租金。

cues.en: This agreement obviously comes rather late.
cues.zh: 这项协议显然来得相当迟。

cues.en: It was reached days after the eviction, and it was reached through intervention of
cues.zh: 协议是在驱逐发生数日后，在律师介入下达成的，

cues.en: lawyers to resolve a situation in which nobody should find themselves.
cues.zh: 旨在解决任何人都不应陷入的处境。

cues.en: With our signatures, this agreement has been concluded,
cues.zh: 有了我们的签字，这项协议就正式达成了，

cues.en: and it means a better and happier result for everybody.
cues.zh: 这意味着对所有人来说都有一个更好、更令人满意的结果。

cues.en: I spoke to our correspondent Guy Hedgecoe in Madrid
cues.zh: 我联系了驻马德里的记者盖伊·赫奇科，

cues.en: and asked him to tell us more.
cues.zh: 请他进一步介绍情况。

cues.en: These measures include protecting vulnerable people from eviction through until 2030.
cues.zh: 这些措施包括保护弱势群体，使其在2030年前免遭驱逐。

cues.en: That was a measure that had been in place for several years previously,
cues.zh: 这项措施此前已实施数年，

cues.en: but it expired earlier this year and was not renewed by the parliament.
cues.zh: 但今年早些时候到期，议会没有续期。

cues.en: So it's not a totally new measure, but it's one that had certainly been demanded by activists and protesters.
cues.zh: 所以这并不是全新的措施，而是活动人士和抗议者一直明确要求的措施。

cues.en: Another measure was the automatic renewal of contracts
cues.zh: 另一项措施是自动续签合同，

cues.en: that are currently rental contracts that are currently in place.
cues.zh: 也就是目前正在执行的租赁合同自动续期。

cues.en: The idea there being to prevent abuses by landlords who might want to raise rents before they agree to the renewal
cues.zh: 这样做是为了防止房东在同意续约前提高租金等滥用行为，

cues.en: of a contract, so they're automatically renewed.
cues.zh: 因此合同会自动续期。

cues.en: Also, there's a clampdown on, or tighter restrictions and tighter regulation of tourist rental properties like Airbnb.
cues.zh: 此外，还将收紧对Airbnb等旅游出租房的限制和监管。

cues.en: That's long been a bone of contention and a target of activists here.
cues.zh: 这一直是争议焦点，也是当地活动人士针对的对象。

cues.en: And single room rentals have also been part of that regulation as well.
cues.zh: 单间出租也属于这项监管的一部分。

cues.en: Guy, any doubt about these new laws being passed and coming into force?
cues.zh: 盖伊，你认为这些新法律能否通过并生效，有疑问吗？

cues.en: Well, yes, I think there is, and that's because they need to go through Congress
cues.zh: 是的，我认为有疑问，因为它们需要提交议会，

cues.en: probably at the end of this week. That's when we're expecting a vote on them.
cues.zh: 预计在本周末审议；我们预计届时会对这些措施投票。

cues.en: This is a decree, but it does need to be approved by lawmakers.
cues.zh: 这是一项法令，但确实需要议员批准。

cues.en: Now, the people where I am, the people who are out on the street who are protesting and demanding these kinds of measures,
cues.zh: 我所在这里走上街头、抗议并要求这类措施的人们，

cues.en: I think certainly a number of these measures will be to their liking,
cues.zh: 我认为其中相当一部分措施肯定会符合他们的心意，

cues.en: we're still waiting for an official response from activists.
cues.zh: 但我们仍在等待活动人士的正式回应。

cues.en: But political parties on the right, for example, are much more reluctant than the parties on the left
cues.zh: 不过，右派政党比左派政党更不愿意

cues.en: to agree to intervening in the housing market, and that's where you might see problems for the government.
cues.zh: 同意干预住房市场，这可能给政府带来问题。

cues.en: It might find it difficult to persuade some of the parties on the right.
cues.zh: 政府可能很难说服一些右派政党。

cues.en: To agree to some of these measures, Guy, you are there.
cues.zh: 盖伊，你正在现场；要让他们同意其中一些措施，情况如何？

cues.en: I mean, how serious is the housing crisis in Spain?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，西班牙的住房危机有多严重？

cues.en: Well, it's very difficult to find affordable housing.
cues.zh: 要找到负担得起的住房非常困难。

cues.en: Certainly in the big cities and in particular in the center of big cities, but across Spain,
cues.zh: 大城市尤其是市中心当然如此，但在整个西班牙，

cues.en: really, recent data showed that on average across Spain, people
cues.zh: 近期数据显示，西班牙民众平均

cues.en: spend 50% of their salary on rental, and that rises
cues.zh: 要把工资的50%花在房租上，这一比例还会升至

cues.en: to around 70% in places like Madrid and Barcelona.
cues.zh: 马德里和巴塞罗那等地的约70%。

cues.en: So it's a real problem, particularly for younger people who find it difficult to find affordable housing,
cues.zh: 所以这确实是个问题，尤其是对难以找到负担得起住房的年轻人来说，

cues.en: and in particular in the cities.
cues.zh: 特别是在城市里。

cues.en: Guy Hedgecoe in Madrid.
cues.zh: 驻马德里的盖伊·赫奇科报道。

cues.en: One of the biggest issues in the news is artificial intelligence, and one
cues.zh: 新闻中最大的议题之一是人工智能，而最大的问题之一是

cues.en: of the biggest questions is how much of a threat AI poses to us.
cues.zh: 人工智能对我们构成的威胁究竟有多大。

cues.en: Now, a key player in the world of artificial intelligence, OpenAI, says it scrapped the planned release
cues.zh: 人工智能领域的主要参与者OpenAI说，它取消了原定发布

cues.en: of its next model due to safety concerns.
cues.zh: 下一代模型的计划，原因是安全担忧。

cues.en: It says GPT-6.1 Astra, which performs tasks like browsing the web and using apps
cues.zh: 该公司说，GPT-6.1 Astra能够自行浏览网页和使用应用，

cues.en: by itself, didn't quite meet the bar of the company's standards.
cues.zh: 但并未完全达到公司的标准。

cues.en: Our business correspondent Maura Fogarty told me more about the concerns that the company revealed about its new model.
cues.zh: 我们的商业记者莫拉·福加蒂向我进一步介绍了公司披露的对新模型的担忧。

cues.en: OpenAI said that this new model went beyond the boundaries that had been established.
cues.zh: OpenAI说，这个新模型超越了既定界限。

cues.en: So, for example, it did things that were beyond the line and did not ask permission to do so.
cues.zh: 例如，它做了越界的事情，而且没有请求许可。

cues.en: The second thing, and this is also quite worrying, is this particular model, when they were testing it, was not being truthful in
cues.zh: 第二点同样令人担忧：测试这个模型时，它没有如实

cues.en: telling the user what it had and hadn't done, so the actions that it had or had not taken, it basically did not tell the truth.
cues.zh: 告诉用户自己做了什么、没做什么；对于已经或尚未采取的行动，它基本上没有说实话。

cues.en: I think this is pretty scary, I have to say.
cues.zh: 我得说，我觉得这相当可怕。

cues.en: So with agentic AI, and this is what it's all about, these are AI systems that can autonomously
cues.zh: 所谓智能代理式人工智能，指的是这类能够自主

cues.en: without prompting by humans, do very complex tasks.
cues.zh: 在无人提示的情况下执行复杂任务的人工智能系统。

cues.en: They also have very complex reasoning abilities as well, and that's very different from the other types of
cues.zh: 它们还具备很强的复杂推理能力，这与其他类型的人工智能

cues.en: say, artificial intelligence like the large language models, which we're much more used to dealing and interacting with
cues.zh: 例如我们更习惯接触和互动的大语言模型不同，

cues.en: when we, you know, for example, ask a question or search something.
cues.zh: 后者通常是我们提出问题或搜索内容时使用的。

cues.en: The agentic ones actually break it down into different tasks and do them autonomously.
cues.zh: 代理式系统则会把任务拆分开来，自主完成。

cues.en: OpenAI has a conference in San Francisco where they've been expected to unveil this new model.
cues.zh: OpenAI将在旧金山举行会议，外界原本预计他们会在那里发布这个新模型。

cues.en: Very unusual to stop it so close to the event, isn't it?
cues.zh: 就在活动临近时停止发布，非常不寻常，对吧？

cues.en: Does that suggest huge concern at the company, do you think?
cues.zh: 你认为这是否说明公司内部极为担忧？

cues.en: They never definitively said they were going to launch this model at the conference, but
cues.zh: 他们从未明确说过会在会议上发布这个模型，但是

cues.en: yes, considering they're pulling the plug, not only that, they're not saying we're delaying the release;
cues.zh: 是的，考虑到他们叫停了计划，而且他们不是说推迟发布，

cues.en: they're saying we're not releasing it at all.
cues.zh: 而是说完全不会发布。

cues.en: It does suggest that the concern is perhaps a bit sharper.
cues.zh: 这确实表明担忧可能更加严重。

cues.en: And agentic AI, is that what is being developed by other companies?
cues.zh: 其他公司开发的也是代理式人工智能吗？

cues.en: That is sort of the new frontier in terms of the artificial intelligence models that are being developed.
cues.zh: 这在某种程度上是当前开发中的人工智能模型的新前沿。

cues.en: OpenAI and Anthropic in the United States are at the forefront of this, but there are companies in China
cues.zh: 美国的OpenAI和Anthropic处于这一领域的前沿，但中国也有公司

cues.en: for example, that are also developing this, and many others, you know, around the world that are trying.
cues.zh: 在开发这类技术，世界各地还有许多其他公司也在尝试。

cues.en: But these two, Anthropic and OpenAI, are leading the way because they've had the most success with them so far.
cues.zh: 但Anthropic和OpenAI这两家公司目前领先，因为它们在这方面取得的成功最多。

cues.en: We have had an increasingly loud chorus from the CEOs of both
cues.zh: Anthropic和OpenAI两家公司的首席执行官越来越频繁地表示，

cues.en: Anthropic and OpenAI suggesting that perhaps the pace of development
cues.zh: 或许模型开发的速度

cues.en: of these artificial intelligence models should be slowed down just a little bit because they're worried about the repercussions
cues.zh: 应该稍微放慢一些，因为他们担心其后果，

cues.en: of, you know, the agentic AI being out there and not fully understanding what those consequences could be.
cues.zh: 担心代理式人工智能投入使用后，人们还无法完全了解可能造成的后果。

cues.en: Maura Fogarty.
cues.zh: 莫拉·福加蒂报道。

cues.en: For many years, there was strong public sympathy in Malaysia for the approximately 750,000 Rohingyas driven out of Myanmar by the military in 2017.
cues.zh: 多年来，马来西亚民众一直非常同情约75万名罗兴亚人；他们在2017年被缅甸军方驱逐出境。

cues.en: Many of the Muslim minority eventually made their way to Malaysia in search of sanctuary and work, and it's thought about 200,000 are there, eking out a living.
cues.zh: 这个穆斯林少数族群中的许多人最终来到马来西亚寻求庇护和工作，据估计约有20万人在那里勉强谋生。

cues.en: But now the Malaysian government has started repatriating around 5,000 asylum seekers from Myanmar, including many Rohingyas,
cues.zh: 但现在，马来西亚政府开始遣返约5000名来自缅甸的寻求庇护者，其中包括许多罗兴亚人，

cues.en: under a controversial deal agreed with Myanmar's military ruler.
cues.zh: 这依据的是一项与缅甸军方统治者达成的有争议协议。

cues.en: Our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head, gave me the details.
cues.zh: 我们的东南亚记者乔纳森·赫德介绍了详情。

cues.en: This is the first stage. The first 1,476 people have been taken by bus already to the Malaysian port of Lumut.
cues.zh: 这是第一阶段。首批1476人已经被大巴送往马来西亚的卢穆特港。

cues.en: It's a navy port. They're being put on board three Myanmar navy ships.
cues.zh: 那是一个海军港口。他们将登上三艘缅甸海军舰艇。

cues.en: They will then have a very long journey; we think it might take them a week.
cues.zh: 随后他们将踏上漫长旅程；我们认为这可能需要一周。

cues.en: They will travel across the Andaman Sea and be taken back to Myanmar.
cues.zh: 他们将穿越安达曼海，被送回缅甸。

cues.en: What we don't know is exactly who these people are.
cues.zh: 我们不知道的是，这些人究竟是谁。

cues.en: They've been held in detention centres.
cues.zh: 他们一直被关押在拘留中心。

cues.en: There are more than 10,000 people being held in detention centres around Malaysia.
cues.zh: 马来西亚各地拘留中心关押着一万多人。

cues.en: They are Myanmar nationals. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has said they include Rohingyas.
cues.zh: 他们是缅甸国民。总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣说，其中包括罗兴亚人。

cues.en: But at this stage, the Malaysian authorities are not confirming or denying that.
cues.zh: 但现阶段，马来西亚当局既不确认，也不否认这一点。

cues.en: Rohingyas are not viewed as citizens by the Myanmar government.
cues.zh: 缅甸政府不承认罗兴亚人是公民。

cues.en: They are not allowed to live anywhere in Myanmar aside from Rakhine State.
cues.zh: 除了若开邦，他们不被允许居住在缅甸的任何地方。

cues.en: Rakhine State is currently a war zone, with intense conflict going on.
cues.zh: 若开邦目前是战区，那里正发生激烈冲突。

cues.en: No one can work out how Rohingyas could be sent back.
cues.zh: 没有人能想明白，罗兴亚人怎么可能被送回去。

cues.en: But the real issue in Malaysia relating to immigrants from Myanmar is particularly focused on the Rohingyas.
cues.zh: 但在马来西亚，涉及缅甸移民的真正问题尤其集中在罗兴亚人身上。

cues.en: There have been some very nasty social media campaigns against them. There's a lot of public hostility.
cues.zh: 社交媒体上出现了一些针对他们的恶意宣传，公众敌意也很强。

cues.en: So that's where the focus has been. We'll wait to see what the composition of these returnees is.
cues.zh: 所以关注点就在这里。我们将等待了解这些被遣返者的构成。

cues.en: Perhaps we might get more information when the rest of them get sent back in the next few weeks.
cues.zh: 也许在未来几周其余人员被送回后，我们会得到更多信息。

cues.en: But human rights groups have condemned this repatriation, haven't they?
cues.zh: 但人权组织谴责了这次遣返，对吗？

cues.en: They have, and the UN refugee agency, the UNHCR, has said it has been barred from having any involvement at all in this.
cues.zh: 是的。联合国难民署表示，自己被完全排除在这件事之外。

cues.en: Malaysia is increasingly keeping the UN refugee agency out, wanting to control the process of deciding whether somebody is or isn't a refugee itself.
cues.zh: 马来西亚越来越把联合国难民署排除在外，想自行控制判定某人是否为难民的过程。

cues.en: Because there's been no independent screening, it's impossible to say that this is voluntary.
cues.zh: 由于没有独立筛查，不可能说这次遣返是自愿的。

cues.en: Human rights groups also say anyone going back to Myanmar now is vulnerable to persecution.
cues.zh: 人权组织还表示，现在回到缅甸的人都可能遭受迫害。

cues.en: They could get caught up in the violence of the civil war or be dragged into forced conscription, which the Myanmar military imposes if they're men.
cues.zh: 他们可能卷入内战暴力，或者被强行征召入伍；缅甸军方会对男性实施这种征召。

cues.en: But obviously, if Rohingyas were included in that, they cannot even go back to most of Myanmar.
cues.zh: 但显然，如果其中包括罗兴亚人，他们甚至无法回到缅甸大部分地区。

cues.en: If they went to the small part of Rakhine State under government control, they'd be confined to miserable camps.
cues.zh: 如果他们前往由政府控制的若开邦小部分地区，也会被困在悲惨的营地里。

cues.en: That would make their plight even greater.
cues.zh: 那会让他们的处境更加悲惨。

cues.en: But the Malaysian government has said, we've got too many, they have to go. It's not been listening.
cues.zh: 但马来西亚政府说：我们这里人太多了，他们必须离开。政府没有听取反对意见。

cues.en: Is it surprising it's happening under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim himself, a political prisoner and a defender of human rights in the past?
cues.zh: 这件事发生在安瓦尔·易卜拉欣任内，是否令人意外？他过去曾是政治犯，也曾捍卫人权。

cues.en: Some of his former supporters have called him out on this and said, you're betraying the very principles you've stood by.
cues.zh: 他的一些前支持者对此公开批评他，说：你背叛了自己一直坚持的原则。

cues.en: But he's not alone. In the past, all Malaysian leaders tended to say we need to support the Rohingyas.
cues.zh: 但他并非孤例。过去，马来西亚历届领导人都倾向于说，我们需要支持罗兴亚人。

cues.en: There was an unofficial policy of tolerance when there was a lot of public sympathy for them.
cues.zh: 当公众非常同情他们时，马来西亚存在一项非正式的宽容政策。

cues.en: The public mood has shifted sharply. There's been a real increase in hostility towards Rohingyas.
cues.zh: 公众情绪发生了急剧转变，对罗兴亚人的敌意明显增加。

cues.en: There are thought to be about 200,000 of them in Malaysia, and Prime Minister Anwar himself is politically embattled.
cues.zh: 据认为，马来西亚约有20万名罗兴亚人；安瓦尔总理本人也陷入政治困境。

cues.en: He leads a fragile coalition. He's been in power for nearly four years. His popularity has plunged.
cues.zh: 他领导着一个脆弱的执政联盟，执政近四年，支持率已经暴跌。

cues.en: I think the reason they're not saying whether Rohingyas are or are not on board this first consignment is precisely because
cues.zh: 我认为，他们不说这批首批遣返者中是否有罗兴亚人，正是因为

cues.en: he wants people to believe they are on board and that he's addressing these public concerns about immigration.
cues.zh: 他希望人们相信其中有罗兴亚人，并相信他正在回应公众对移民问题的担忧。

cues.en: Jonathan Head in the Thai capital, Bangkok.
cues.zh: 乔纳森·赫德在泰国首都曼谷报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast, the US journalist Evan Gershkovich on life after being released from a Russian prison.
cues.zh: 本期播客接下来将播出美国记者埃文·格尔什科维奇谈获释后生活的内容；他曾被关押在俄罗斯监狱。

cues.en: You're overwhelmed by the sights and sounds. I would freeze and have panic attacks from crowds of people. In prison,
cues.zh: 你会被眼前的景象和周围的声音压垮。面对人群，我会僵住并出现惊恐发作。在监狱里，

cues.en: I'd made this decision to go through it stoically. I thought that if I ever let myself break down into tears in prison,
cues.zh: 我决定坚忍地熬过去。我想，如果我在监狱里任由自己崩溃哭泣，

cues.en: everything would collapse.
cues.zh: 一切都会垮掉。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: The deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading, with confirmed cases surpassing 8,000 and nearly 4,000 deaths.
cues.zh: 刚果民主共和国致命的埃博拉疫情仍在蔓延，确诊病例已超过8000例，死亡人数近4000人。

cues.en: Two more areas have been affected, one near the Central African Republic and another on the border with South Sudan.
cues.zh: 另有两个地区受到影响：一个靠近中非共和国，另一个位于南苏丹边境。

cues.en: But it's emerged that the number of people exposed to Ebola could be much greater than official figures suggest.
cues.zh: 但现在看来，接触过埃博拉病毒的人数可能远高于官方数字。

cues.en: The Africa Centers for Disease Control says only around 30,000 potential contacts have been identified.
cues.zh: 非洲疾病控制中心说，目前只确认了大约3万名潜在接触者。

cues.en: The CDC director general, Dr Jean Kaseya, told Katherine Byaruhanga that this could be a fraction of the true figure.
cues.zh: 非洲疾控中心总干事让·卡塞亚医生告诉凯瑟琳·拜鲁汉加，这可能只是实际数字的一小部分。

cues.en: We look at the number of confirmed cases, community deaths and transmission patterns.
cues.zh: 我们会考察确诊病例数、社区死亡人数和传播模式。

cues.en: We estimate that the real number of people who should have been identified and followed is really underestimated.
cues.zh: 我们估计，本应被识别并追踪的人数实际上被严重低估了。

cues.en: It could be several hundred thousand people.
cues.zh: 这个数字可能达到几十万人。

cues.en: We think that there are some reasons for this gap.
cues.zh: 我们认为，造成这一差距有几个原因。

cues.en: The first one is that too many cases are detected late.
cues.zh: 第一，太多病例发现得太晚。

cues.en: The second is that many deaths still occur in communities rather than in treatment facilities.
cues.zh: 第二，许多死亡仍发生在社区，而不是治疗机构内。

cues.en: And the third one is that the outbreak is in an area where insecurity, displacement and population movement is so high.
cues.zh: 第三，疫情发生在一个不安全、人口流离失所且流动性很高的地区。

cues.en: I can also add that community engagement is not really strong enough.
cues.zh: 我还要补充一点：社区参与度还不够高。

cues.en: Without communities driving and leading the response, there will be a lot of suspicion and we will not contain this outbreak.
cues.zh: 如果没有社区推动并主导应对，就会有大量猜疑，我们也无法控制这场疫情。

cues.en: The outbreak has spread to towns close to the borders with South Sudan and the Central African Republic.
cues.zh: 疫情已蔓延到靠近南苏丹和中非共和国边境的城镇。

cues.en: Countries that have faced years of conflict also have weak health-care systems.
cues.zh: 这些历经多年冲突的国家，医疗系统也很薄弱。

cues.en: How confident are you that the virus won't spread into those countries and that they are prepared to deal with any potential outbreak?
cues.zh: 你有多大把握相信病毒不会传入这些国家，而且它们已准备好应对任何潜在疫情？

cues.en: I had the opportunity to visit South Sudan and the Central African Republic.
cues.zh: 我曾有机会访问南苏丹和中非共和国。

cues.en: We are providing huge support for preparedness in these two countries.
cues.zh: 我们正在为这两个国家的防疫准备提供大力支持。

cues.en: In terms of preparedness, we are doing our best,
cues.zh: 在防疫准备方面，我们正在尽最大努力，

cues.en: but the health systems in these two countries remain a major issue,
cues.zh: 但这两个国家的医疗系统仍是一个重大问题，

cues.en: and I cannot assure you that the outbreak will not cross the border, will not be in CAR or in South Sudan.
cues.zh: 我无法向你保证疫情不会越过边境，不会进入中非共和国或南苏丹。

cues.en: I cannot say that, but we are doing our best to support the DRC government in controlling the outbreak in the DRC.
cues.zh: 这一点我无法断言，但我们会尽最大努力支持刚果（金）政府控制刚果（金）的疫情。

cues.en: And if unfortunately we could have cases in these two countries, we'll provide appropriate support to contain that.
cues.zh: 如果不幸这两个国家出现病例，我们会提供适当支持加以控制。

cues.en: Dr Jean Kaseya.
cues.zh: 让·卡塞亚医生。

cues.en: Next, a story from the United States began tragically with the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in 1995.
cues.zh: 接下来是一则来自美国的报道：19岁的科琳·斯莱默于1995年被谋杀，悲剧由此开始。

cues.en: And it may end on Wednesday with the execution by lethal injection of her killer, Christa Pike.
cues.zh: 而周三，她的凶手克丽丝塔·派克可能会被注射死刑，故事或将结束。

cues.en: She was just 18 at the time and has been on death row for 30 years.
cues.zh: 她当时只有18岁，已经在死囚牢房里度过了30年。

cues.en: On Monday, the governor of Tennessee said he would not intervene in the case and, barring a last-minute reprieve,
cues.zh: 周一，田纳西州州长表示不会干预此案；除非最后一刻获得缓刑，

cues.en: Christa Pike, who's now 50 years old, will be the first woman to be executed in the state in more than 200 years.
cues.zh: 现年50岁的克丽丝塔·派克将成为该州200多年来首位被执行死刑的女性。

cues.en: The BBC's Stephanie Hegarty has been looking into the story for us.
cues.zh: BBC记者斯蒂芬妮·赫加蒂为我们调查了这起事件。

cues.en: Colleen Slemmer and Christa Pike met at a training camp for troubled teens in 1995.
cues.zh: 科琳·斯莱默和克丽丝塔·派克于1995年在一个问题青少年训练营相遇。

cues.en: Colleen was 19, Christa was 18, and they came to blows.
cues.zh: 科琳19岁，克丽丝塔18岁，两人发生了冲突。

cues.en: Christa, at the time, accused Colleen of trying to steal her boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp.
cues.zh: 当时，克丽丝塔指责科琳企图抢走她的男友塔达里尔·希普。

cues.en: And Tadaryl and Christa lured Colleen into a wood where they brutally murdered and tortured her.
cues.zh: 塔达里尔和克丽丝塔把科琳引到树林里，残忍地杀害并折磨了她。

cues.en: There was a huge media frenzy around this story at the time because Tadaryl Shipp later said that he carved a pentagram into Colleen Slemmer's chest.
cues.zh: 当时这起事件引发媒体狂热，因为塔达里尔·希普后来称，他在科琳·斯莱默的胸口刻下了五芒星。

cues.en: And this was the time of the satanic panic in the US, when there was a lot of fear around teenagers engaging in Satanism.
cues.zh: 当时美国正处于“撒旦恐慌”时期，社会十分担心青少年参与撒旦教活动。

cues.en: So it was a very big trial in Tennessee at the time.
cues.zh: 所以，当时这在田纳西州是一场轰动的审判。

cues.en: Tadaryl Shipp was 17, so although he took part in the murder and torture as well,
cues.zh: 塔达里尔·希普当时17岁，虽然他也参与了谋杀和折磨，

cues.en: he was never eligible for the death penalty, and he got life with the chance of parole.
cues.zh: 他从未符合死刑资格，而是被判终身监禁，并有假释机会。

cues.en: He sought parole last year, but it was denied.
cues.zh: 他去年申请假释，但遭到拒绝。

cues.en: Whereas Christa Pike, on the other hand, was 18.
cues.zh: 而克丽丝塔·派克当时18岁。

cues.en: So she was eligible for the death penalty, and she was convicted and sentenced to death in 1996.
cues.zh: 因此她符合死刑资格，并于1996年被定罪、判处死刑。

cues.en: There have been years of failed appeals, haven't there?
cues.zh: 这些年来她的上诉都失败了，对吗？

cues.en: And her defence team have always said that she was a victim. Tell us about her case.
cues.zh: 她的辩护团队一直说她也是受害者。请介绍一下她的案件。

cues.en: So this didn't come up so much in the trial itself, but in the years since,
cues.zh: 这在审判本身并未受到太多关注，但在此后的多年里，

cues.en: several defence teams who've been representing Christa have uncovered a lot of evidence of really severe and traumatic childhood abuse.
cues.zh: 代表克丽丝塔的几组辩护团队发现了大量证据，显示她童年遭受过极其严重且创伤性的虐待。

cues.en: Now this was available to her defence team at the time, but it wasn't presented, at least not in great detail, in the sentencing part of her trial.
cues.zh: 这些资料当时已经交给她的辩护团队，但至少在审判量刑阶段并未详细呈现。

cues.en: So it's emerged that she was sexually abused right back to when she was a toddler by one of her grandmother's boyfriends,
cues.zh: 后来发现，她从幼儿时期起就遭到祖母的一名男友性侵，

cues.en: that she suffered severe neglect at the hands of her father and her mother.
cues.zh: 还遭受父母严重的疏于照料。

cues.en: Her mother had many different husbands and boyfriends, some of whom abused Christa sexually and physically.
cues.zh: 她的母亲有过许多丈夫和男友，其中一些人对克丽丝塔实施了性虐待和身体虐待。

cues.en: She was raped at eleven, at 14 and again at 17.
cues.zh: 她11岁、14岁和17岁时都曾遭到强奸。

cues.en: So this was a young person who was experiencing extreme trauma at the time of the crime.
cues.zh: 也就是说，案发时她还是一个正在经历极度创伤的年轻人。

cues.en: The last rape that she experienced was almost to the day a year before the crime,
cues.zh: 她最后一次遭到强奸，距离这起罪案几乎正好一年，

cues.en: and Christa Pike's current defence team have said that all of this contributed to her mindset at the time.
cues.zh: 克丽丝塔·派克目前的辩护团队表示，所有这些经历都影响了她当时的心态。

cues.en: She's also, since the trial, been diagnosed with bipolar disorder.
cues.zh: 此外，她在审判后被诊断患有双相情感障碍。

cues.en: She's been treated for that in prison, and her defence team say since she's had the appropriate treatment, she's a much different person.
cues.zh: 她在狱中接受了治疗；辩护团队称，得到适当治疗后，她已经判若两人。

cues.en: But we should say the family of the woman who was killed, Colleen Slemmer, they want the execution to go ahead.
cues.zh: 但也要说明，被杀害的科琳·斯莱默的家人希望执行死刑。

cues.en: Yes, Colleen's mother, May Martinez, has been saying that she won't find peace until Christa Pike is executed.
cues.zh: 是的，科琳的母亲梅·马丁内斯一直说，只有克丽丝塔·派克被处决，她才能得到安宁。

cues.en: She's certainly encouraging it to go ahead, and she said she will travel from Florida, where she lives, to Tennessee to witness Christa Pike's death.
cues.zh: 她当然在推动行刑，并表示会从居住地佛罗里达前往田纳西，见证克丽丝塔·派克的死亡。

cues.en: Stephanie Hegarty. For 16 months, Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich was held in a Russian prison,
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·赫加蒂报道。16个月来，《华尔街日报》记者埃文·格尔什科维奇一直被关押在俄罗斯监狱，

cues.en: the first U.S. journalist to be charged with espionage in Russia since the Cold War.
cues.zh: 他是冷战以来首位在俄罗斯被控从事间谍活动的美国记者。

cues.en: He was arrested in March 2023, a year after Russia invaded Ukraine, and was eventually released in a prisoner swap.
cues.zh: 他于2023年3月被捕，当时俄罗斯入侵乌克兰已有一年，最终通过囚犯交换获释。

cues.en: It was the images of a young man in a glass-walled dock and his newspaper's attempts to free him that made news around the world.
cues.zh: 这名年轻男子站在玻璃围栏被告席中的画面，以及报社试图营救他的行动，成为全球新闻。

cues.en: And now he's turned that experience into a book.
cues.zh: 现在，他把这段经历写成了一本书。

cues.en: That first appearance in court was about three and a half weeks after my first arrest, and nobody had gotten any images of me by that point.
cues.zh: 我第一次出庭是在首次被捕约三周半后；那时还没有人拍到我的任何画面。

cues.en: And I, within about a week, week and a half, started settling into this idea that okay, it's going to be for a swap.
cues.zh: 大约一周、一周半后，我开始接受这样一个想法：好吧，我会被用来交换。

cues.en: Being held in the conditions of Lefortovo Prison in Moscow, which is this really isolating experience.
cues.zh: 被关在莫斯科列福尔托沃监狱，那是一段极其与世隔绝的经历。

cues.en: You only have one cellmate; you're moved around without seeing any other prisoners.
cues.zh: 你只有一名狱友；被带来带去，却见不到其他囚犯。

cues.en: That really wears on you psychologically, but I was allowed to sleep, the food was fine,
cues.zh: 这在心理上确实令人疲惫，但我可以睡觉，食物也还不错，

cues.en: I'm being treated okay, so I sort of settle in,
cues.zh: 我受到的待遇还可以，所以也算适应了下来，

cues.en: but prison's a black box for everybody else around.
cues.zh: 但对周围其他人来说，监狱就是一个黑箱。

cues.en: Your loved ones are worried about you, your colleagues, and so I thought of that appearance
cues.zh: 你的亲人和同事都会为你担心，所以我把那次出庭看作

cues.en: as a way to show people I was doing okay and give them a sense of belief, you know, and calm around it.
cues.zh: 向大家表明我还好，让他们感到安心，并对这件事保持平静。

cues.en: And I also wanted to smile as much as I could,
cues.zh: 我也想尽可能地微笑，

cues.en: but really, you know, more than a smile, I guess a smirk, because I wanted to show people this kind of defiance.
cues.zh: 但其实，与其说是微笑，我想更像是冷笑，因为我想向大家表现出这种反抗。

cues.en: All of us understood, all of us are in on the joke in a way.
cues.zh: 我们都明白，我们都以某种方式参与了这场玩笑。

cues.en: We know that this is a fabricated case, and so if this is a game of theater,
cues.zh: 我们知道这是一起捏造的案件，所以如果这是一场戏，

cues.en: let's not let them have it play out the way they want it to.
cues.zh: 就别让他们按自己想要的方式把戏演下去。

cues.en: And then you had this period of time, this three weeks, where you knew that the swap was going to happen.
cues.zh: 接下来是三周的等待期，你知道交换即将发生。

cues.en: When it comes, what is that moment like?
cues.zh: 那一刻到来时，感觉是什么样的？

cues.en: It's a bit of an overwhelming feeling because you're so used to being an institutionalized person
cues.zh: 那种感觉有些令人不知所措，因为你已经习惯了被关在机构里的生活，

cues.en: that you're sort of scared of getting out into the real world.
cues.zh: 反而有点害怕回到真实世界。

cues.en: And then those three weeks until the swap happens is excruciating because now every day is painfully long.
cues.zh: 而在交换发生前的三周里，等待令人煎熬，因为现在每一天都格外漫长。

cues.en: You're just hoping that the swap is going to happen tomorrow.
cues.zh: 你只是盼着交换能在明天发生。

cues.en: And then when it takes place, it's just pure joy.
cues.zh: 而当交换真的发生时，只有纯粹的喜悦。

cues.en: I don't think I've ever experienced joy like that before.
cues.zh: 我想此前从未体验过那样的喜悦。

cues.en: And what about the days and weeks afterwards, where suddenly you are back in your normal life in many ways, but everything's changed?
cues.zh: 那之后的几天和几周呢？你在许多方面突然回到正常生活，但一切都变了？

cues.en: Yeah, and then, you know, the joy fades, the adrenaline subsides, and you are faced with the reality of having returned to normal life again.
cues.zh: 是的，喜悦会消退，肾上腺素会平息，你不得不面对再次回归正常生活的现实。

cues.en: You know, you are overwhelmed by the sights and sounds. I would freeze and have panic attacks from crowds of people.
cues.zh: 你会被周围的所见所闻压倒；面对人群，我会僵住并惊恐发作。

cues.en: In prison, I'd made this decision to sort of go through it stoically.
cues.zh: 在监狱里，我决定以近乎冷静克制的方式熬过去。

cues.en: I thought that if I ever let myself break down into tears in prison, you know,
cues.zh: 我想，如果我在监狱里让自己崩溃哭出来，

cues.en: everything would collapse and I wouldn't be able to deal with it anymore.
cues.zh: 一切都会垮掉，我再也无法应对。

cues.en: And so that all started flowing out once I was outside.
cues.zh: 所以出狱后，这些情绪全都开始宣泄出来。

cues.en: So I had to get therapists. I worked with psychiatrists who dealt with PTSD and we worked on that for six months.
cues.zh: 所以我不得不找治疗师。我和专门治疗创伤后应激障碍的精神科医生合作了六个月。

cues.en: And, you know, doing this book, this book is a kind of product that I think is therapy in a way.
cues.zh: 写这本书的过程，这本书本身在某种程度上也是一种疗愈。

cues.en: You know, it's both personal and what I want for public consumption at the same time.
cues.zh: 它既是私人的，也包含我希望公开分享的内容。

cues.en: For the public, it memorializes not just my story, but this period in Russian history.
cues.zh: 对公众而言，这不仅记录了我的故事，也记录了俄罗斯历史上的这段时期。

cues.en: On a personal level, you're sort of looking at this traumatic event and having to process it, having to speak about it.
cues.zh: 就个人而言，你要面对这场创伤性事件，消化它，并不得不谈论它。

cues.en: So now, looking at it from a couple of years later, it feels like any old experience in a way.
cues.zh: 所以，几年后回头看，这在某种程度上感觉就像一段普通经历。

cues.en: It informs your daily life, but it's not something you think about consciously.
cues.zh: 它影响着你的日常生活，但不是你会有意识去想的事情。

cues.en: Evan Gershkovich talking to Anna Foster, and his book is called This Cursed Beautiful Land, a Russian Story.
cues.zh: 以上是埃文·格尔什科维奇接受安娜·福斯特采访；他的书名是《这片受诅咒的美丽土地：一个俄罗斯故事》。

cues.en: Back in 2010, the film The Social Network was released.
cues.zh: 2010年，电影《社交网络》上映。

cues.en: It explored the rise of Facebook and its founder, Mark Zuckerberg.
cues.zh: 影片讲述了脸书及其创始人马克·扎克伯格的崛起。

cues.en: Sixteen years later, there's much more to say.
cues.zh: 16年后，关于这个故事还有更多可说的。

cues.en: So the Oscar, Emmy and Golden Globe-winning writer and director Aaron Sorkin
cues.zh: 于是，曾获奥斯卡、艾美奖和金球奖的编剧兼导演艾伦·索金

cues.en: has picked up the story once again in a new film, The Social Reckoning.
cues.zh: 在新片《社交清算》中再次讲述这个故事。

cues.en: Its focus this time is Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen and journalist Jeff Horwitz.
cues.zh: 这一次，影片聚焦脸书举报人弗朗西斯·豪根和记者杰夫·霍尔维茨。

cues.en: The movie delves into the story behind the company's genesis, looking at what social media has become.
cues.zh: 影片深入讲述公司的创立故事，并审视社交媒体如今变成了什么。

cues.en: Facebook wants you to stay on the site for as long as possible.
cues.zh: 脸书希望你尽可能长时间留在网站上。

cues.en: And two years ago, the algorithm was changed.
cues.zh: 两年前，算法发生了改变。

cues.en: Wait, Mark, we're trying to address hate speech, and we're going to amplify and turbocharge it.
cues.zh: 等等，马克，我们正试图处理仇恨言论，你们却要放大并加速传播它。

cues.en: The debate is over.
cues.zh: 争论结束了。

cues.en: Aaron Sorkin told the BBC what drew him to revisit the Facebook story.
cues.zh: 艾伦·索金告诉BBC，是什么吸引他再次讲述脸书的故事。

cues.en: What began as a cool idea, a way to keep in touch with the people you went to school with,
cues.zh: 它起初是个酷点子，让你能与同学保持联系，

cues.en: for guys, sort of an easier introduction to girls,
cues.zh: 对男孩来说，也算是更轻松地认识女孩的方式，

cues.en: became something huge and frankly monstrous, a machine for pumping out misinformation and making people angry.
cues.zh: 后来变成了庞大而且说实话很可怕的东西，一台制造错误信息、激怒人们的机器。

cues.en: Frances, who's played by Mikey Madison in the film, is a young engineer at Facebook.
cues.zh: 影片中，弗朗西斯由迈琪·麦迪逊饰演；她是脸书的一名年轻工程师。

cues.en: She went to Facebook specifically because they had this one division, the Civic Integrity Team,
cues.zh: 她之所以专门加入脸书，是因为那里有一个部门——公民诚信团队，

cues.en: which, whereas every other team at Facebook is concentrated on growth, was supposed to be the one team that wasn't.
cues.zh: 脸书其他团队都专注于增长，而这个团队本应是唯一不这样做的团队。

cues.en: They were concentrated, frankly, on civic misinformation.
cues.zh: 说实话，他们专注的是公民领域的错误信息。

cues.en: And she became shocked at what she found when a friend of hers had become completely radicalized by Facebook
cues.zh: 当她发现自己的朋友被脸书彻底激进化时，她感到震惊，

cues.en: in a very short period of time.
cues.zh: 而这一切只发生在很短的时间内。

cues.en: That's what sent Frances on her journey, and she engaged the help of Jeff Horwitz,
cues.zh: 这促使弗朗西斯踏上了这段旅程，她还寻求了杰夫·霍尔维茨的帮助，

cues.en: a Wall Street Journal investigative reporter.
cues.zh: 他是《华尔街日报》的调查记者。

cues.en: He's played by Jeremy Allen White, and together they uncovered these incredible secrets.
cues.zh: 片中由杰里米·艾伦·怀特饰演；他们一起揭开了这些惊人的秘密。

cues.en: You know, people asked me as they were signing up for the film
cues.zh: 人们在签约参与这部电影时问我，

cues.en: whether it was our cinematographer or set designer or actors, by being part of this movie,
cues.zh: 无论是摄影师、布景设计师还是演员，参与这部电影，

cues.en: is there a chance that I will be rendered to an El Salvadoran prison?
cues.zh: 有没有可能我会被送进萨尔瓦多的监狱？

cues.en: The fact is, though, that I think Sony, the studio making the movie,
cues.zh: 不过事实是，我认为制作这部电影的索尼公司，

cues.en: has been, in times like this, you have to call it brave, you have to call it courageous to make the movie.
cues.zh: 在这样的时代拍这部电影，你必须说它勇敢，必须说它有勇气。

cues.en: It shouldn't be, but it is.
cues.zh: 本不该如此，但事实就是如此。

cues.en: I like writing about institutions, the people in those institutions, but institutions.
cues.zh: 我喜欢写机构，写机构中的人，但归根结底还是写机构。

cues.en: In this case, The Social Network was about how Facebook was invented.
cues.zh: 在这个故事里，《社交网络》讲的是脸书如何诞生。

cues.en: The Social Reckoning is about what it's become and specifically Facebook's role
cues.zh: 《社交清算》讲的是脸书如今变成了什么，尤其是脸书所扮演的角色，

cues.en: in the rise of extremism, divisiveness and violence.
cues.zh: 以及它在极端主义、分裂和暴力兴起中的作用。

cues.en: I wasn't like I was looking to do a follow-up to The Social Network, to do another story about Facebook or another story about Mark Zuckerberg.
cues.zh: 我并不是想为《社交网络》拍续篇，也不是想再讲一个脸书或马克·扎克伯格的故事。

cues.en: I was looking for a good story to tell and there was this.
cues.zh: 我只是想找个好故事来讲，而这个故事正好出现了。

cues.en: And that's it from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是我们目前的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also now watch our episodes in full. Just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 现在也可以观看我们的完整节目，只需在YouTube上搜索Global News Podcast。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Rosanna Windorall.
cues.zh: 本期由罗莎娜·温多拉尔混音。

cues.en: The producer was Adrian White. The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 制片人是阿德里安·怀特，编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Valerie Sanderson. Until next time, bye-bye.
cues.zh: 我是瓦莱丽·桑德森。下次再见。
